text:
It’s the 154th edition of the oldest golf tournament in the world.
, features much of the world’s top golf talent, including the No. 1, 2 and 3 golfers worldwide, Scottie Scheffler, Rory McIlroy and Matt Fitzpatrick, respectively.
Due to the time difference, things get started pretty early if you’re in the United States, but the final groups tee off just before 11:30 a.m. ET, so there’s plenty of golf to be watched during the morning and afternoon.
